title: Georgia Travel Guide
summary: A complete Georgia travel guide for Indian visitors, with visa tips, summer and winter highlights, Batumi coastal escapes, wine country, and mountain adventures.
bestTime: May–September for beach, wine and hiking; December–March for snow, skiing and festive city escapes.

quickFacts.Visa: Visa-free for many Indians for short stays; confirm latest e-visa rules.

attractions.name: Batumi Boulevard
attractions.summary: A lively sea promenade with modern sculptures, beach clubs, and café culture on the Black Sea coast.

attractions.name: Tbilisi Old Town
attractions.summary: Historic alleyways, sulfur baths, and vibrant street life in Georgia’s capital city.

attractions.name: Kakheti Wine Road
attractions.summary: Ancient vineyards, qvevri wine tastings, and charming wineries around Telavi.

attractions.name: Svaneti & Ushguli
attractions.summary: A mountain region of tower villages, dramatic alpine views, and high-altitude hiking.

attractions.name: Mtskheta
attractions.summary: Georgia’s spiritual heart with Svetitskhoveli Cathedral and hilltop Jvari Monastery.

cultureEtiquette: Show respect in churches and monasteries with modest clothing.
Use both hands when offering or receiving items to show politeness.
Accept invitations to taste local cuisine and join a Georgian supra when offered.
gettingAround: Take local minibuses (marshrutkas) between cities for an authentic budget experience.
Book taxis through apps like Bolt and Yandex for reliable short trips.
Rent a car for Kakheti wine tours or day trips to mountain regions like Svaneti.

itineraries.title: Batumi Coast & Culture
activities: Enjoy the beach and local seafood

itineraries.title: Mountain Highlights
activities: Drive to Mtskheta for heritage sites
Sample khachapuri in a local café

sustainability: Choose locally owned guesthouses to support the community.
Carry a reusable bottle and avoid single-use plastics around tourist sites.
Respect natural areas in Svaneti and Batumi beaches by staying on marked trails.

faqs.q: Do Indian travelers need a visa for Georgia?
faqs.a: Many Indian passports qualify for short-term visa-free travel to Georgia, but check the latest embassy guidelines before departure.

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit Batumi?
faqs.a: June to September is ideal for the seaside, while October is great for wine country and cooler weather.

faqs.q: Can I use Indian rupees in Georgia?
faqs.a: No, Georgia uses the Georgian lari (GEL); exchange currency at airports or local banks.
